name: Vitex agnus-castus extract
description: Vitex agnus-castus extract (CAS 91722-47-3 ), also known as Vitex Extract or Hayıt Ekstrakt, is derived from the berries and leaves of the chaste tree. It is sourced for its bioactive compounds, primarily flavonoids and iridoid glycosides. The extract is used across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic formulations for its antioxidant and hormone-modulating support functions. In dietary supplement manufacturing, it is incorporated into capsules, tablets, and softgels. These applications typically target women's health and hormonal balance formulations. Functional food and beverage producers use it as a botanical antioxidant ingredient in standardized blends to enhance product value. Pharmaceutical formulators source it as an active botanical for OTC preparations and standardized herbal medicinal products in regulated markets. It meets rigorous quality standards for consistent therapeutic efficacy. In personal care, it is used in topical creams and serums where antioxidant-active botanical extracts are required. These ingredients support specific skin formulation claims and provide natural protective benefits. Vitex agnus-castus extract is supplied as a dry powder or as a liquid extract, with dry powder being the predominant commercial form. Standardized grades are available, typically defined by agnuside or casticin content. These standardized options meet consistent potency requirements across batches for industrial scale.
